_meta.description: 4 adult attachment styles — Secure, Anxious, Avoidant, Fearful-Avoidant
_meta.origins: John Bowlby (1969), Mary Ainsworth (1978 Strange Situation), Mary Main & Judith Solomon (1986)

core_belief.en: I am worthy of love; others can be trusted
core_belief.ko: 나는 사랑받을 자격이 있다; 타인을 신뢰할 수 있다

en: may underestimate attachment issues in insecure partners
ko: 불안정 애착 파트너의 문제를 과소평가할 수 있음

healing_path.en: Natural foundation; focus on maintaining and supporting partners with insecure styles
healing_path.ko: 자연스러운 기반; 유지하고 불안정 애착 파트너 지지에 집중

affirmation.en: I am worthy of love and belonging
affirmation.ko: 나는 사랑과 소속을 받을 자격이 있다

core_belief.en: I am unworthy; others might abandon me
core_belief.ko: 나는 부족하다; 타인이 나를 떠날지도 모른다

childhood_origin.en: Inconsistent caregiving — sometimes responsive, sometimes not
childhood_origin.ko: 불일관적 양육 — 반응적일 때도 있고 아닐 때도 있음

en: reads too much into small signals

healing_path.en: Therapy (EMDR, IFS, DBT), journaling, building self-worth independent of relationships, learning to self-soothe
healing_path.ko: 치료(EMDR, IFS, DBT), 저널링, 관계와 독립적인 자존감 구축, 자기 진정 학습

affirmation.en: I am enough. I don't need to earn love
affirmation.ko: 나는 충분하다. 사랑을 얻기 위해 노력할 필요 없다

core_belief.en: I am fine alone; needing others is weakness
core_belief.ko: 혼자도 괜찮다; 타인을 필요로 하는 것은 약함

childhood_origin.en: Emotionally unavailable or rejecting caregivers — learned to suppress needs
childhood_origin.ko: 감정적으로 부재하거나 거부적인 양육자 — 필요를 억압하는 법을 배움

healing_path.en: Therapy (psychodynamic, IFS), practicing vulnerability, connecting needs to body sensations, tolerating intimacy in small steps
healing_path.ko: 치료(심리역동, IFS), 취약성 연습, 필요를 신체 감각과 연결, 친밀감을 작은 단계로 허용

affirmation.en: It is safe to need others. Vulnerability is strength
affirmation.ko: 다른 사람을 필요로 해도 안전하다. 취약함은 강함이다

core_belief.en: I want intimacy but I'm terrified of it

childhood_origin.en: Caregiver was both source of comfort AND fear (abuse, neglect, trauma)
childhood_origin.ko: 양육자가 위로의 원천이자 두려움의 원천 (학대, 방치, 트라우마)

en: alternates between pursuing and pushing away
any perceived threat of abandonment OR enmeshment

healing_path.en: Trauma-focused therapy (EMDR, SE, IFS, DBT), building nervous system regulation, consistent safe relationships
healing_path.ko: 트라우마 중심 치료(EMDR, SE, IFS, DBT), 신경계 조절 구축, 일관된 안전한 관계

affirmation.en: I deserve love and safety. My past does not define my future
affirmation.ko: 나는 사랑과 안전을 받을 자격이 있다. 과거가 미래를 정의하지 않는다

question.en: When your partner is distant or unavailable, you tend to:
question.ko: 파트너가 거리를 두거나 연락이 안 될 때, 당신은 보통:

text.en: Feel anxious and try to reconnect immediately
Give them space and trust it will be fine
Withdraw and focus on other things
Feel both desperate to connect AND want to run away
text.ko: 연결하고 싶기도 하고 도망치고 싶기도 하다

question.en: How comfortable are you with emotional intimacy?

text.en: Very comfortable — I enjoy deep connection
I crave it deeply but worry it won't last
I prefer keeping some emotional distance
text.ko: 어느 정도 감정적 거리를 유지하는 것을 선호한다

text.en: I want it but it feels dangerous

question.en: After an argument with a partner, you typically:

text.en: Work through it together; conflict doesn't destabilize you
text.ko: 함께 해결한다; 갈등이 불안정하게 만들지 않는다

text.en: Keep replaying it and need reassurance it's okay
Shut down and need time alone before engaging
text.ko: 차단하고 참여하기 전에 혼자만의 시간이 필요하다

text.en: Feel overwhelmed and act in ways you later regret

note.en: Secure can provide stability; anxious must work on self-worth
note.ko: 안정형이 안정성 제공; 불안형은 자존감 작업 필요

note.en: Secure can invite avoidant to open up gradually
note.ko: 안정형이 회피형을 점차 열리도록 초대할 수 있음

note.en: Most common toxic pattern — the 'anxious-avoidant trap'
Both dysregulated — needs significant individual healing first
note.ko: 둘 다 조절 어려움 — 개인적 치유가 먼저 필요

note.en: Low drama but emotionally distant; may lack depth
note.ko: 드라마 없지만 감정적으로 거리감; 깊이 부족할 수 있음
